svg.aria-label: Tech stack: Languages (The languages I think and solve problems in): TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, Java. Frontend (Interfaces that are fast, accessible and polished): React, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Vite, TanStack Query, Redux, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Ant Design. Backend (APIs, real-time services and payments): Node.js, Go, AdonisJS, Express.js, JWT, Socket.IO, REST APIs, Stripe, PayPal. Databases (Where the data lives, relational to real-time): MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Valkey, MongoDB, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Supabase. Cloud & DevOps (Shipping, hosting and keeping things fast at the edge): AWS, Cloudflare, CDN, Vercel, Docker, Caddy, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Loki. Developer Tools (What keeps the day-to-day workflow sharp): Git, Turborepo, pnpm, Vitest, ESLint, Postman.
